opportunities.gap: The section's recurring stakes are student-data privacy with minors: 'student responses on an outside server,' 'no district agreement,' 'no named student data collected,' 'whether the district has approved the vendor.' These are precisely FERPA / COPPA / state student-data-privacy concerns, but the MDX prose cites NO specific statute or standard. This is the one section where the privacy law tie-in is most natural and most load-bearing, and the course explicitly stresses FERPA/COPPA. The 2024-2026 COPPA rule update and state school-AI guidance are directly relevant to the 'outside server / vendor approval' mechanism.
opportunities.proposed_change: Add a short 'Recent Evidence' or 'Standard of Care' callout (3-4 sentences) near the Opening Case or Core Concept that names why the mentor's outside-server concern is not mere caution: FERPA governs disclosure of education records to third-party vendors, COPPA governs data from under-13 students, and many districts require a signed data-privacy agreement / vendor approval before student responses leave the school server. Cite current FERPA/COPPA references and note 2024-2026 COPPA amendments and state school-AI data guidance. Keep to one callout, not a new section.
